name: Batch cooking plan
pitch: Plan a Sunday batch-cook that fills the freezer for a fortnight.
instructions: Start by searching for easy batch-cook recipes that freeze well and serve 4–6 portions. When nothing is found, say so and ask the person whether they have a cuisine or ingredient preference. Collect 5 to 7 recipes that together give at least 14 meals. When a recipe is found, note its name, main ingredients, cooking time, and how many portions it makes. When a recipe cannot be found, skip it and move to the next. When all recipes are gathered, use make_page to create a simple table with three columns: Recipe, Portions, Freeze notes. Fill the table with the collected recipes. When a recipe lacks freeze notes, write "Check freezer suitability" in that cell. When the table is complete, show it to the person with show_table. If fewer than 5 recipes are found, tell the person how many were found and ask if they want to add their own or search for more.
starters: "plan a batch cook for two weeks"
readme:
# Batch cooking plan
Plan a Sunday batch-cook that fills the freezer for a fortnight.

What it does: Finds recipes that freeze well, creates a table of what to cook, and shows it so the person can decide.

What it needs: web_search to find recipes, make_page to build the table, show_table to display it.

What it will not do: It cannot cook the food, buy ingredients, or set up a shopping order. It will not invent nutrition facts or cooking times.
